usageNotes: Use this to list all Proxmox VE users visible to the authenticated principal; every authenticated user always sees themselves in the result even with minimal privileges, but the full list is filtered to users where the caller holds 'User.Modify' or 'Sys.Audit' on '/access/groups' or on a group the user belongs to. Pass 'full=true' to include each user's group memberships and API tokens in the response, which is useful for auditing access or building user-management tooling. Users with a non-zero 'expire' timestamp or 'enable=false' are still returned unless you filter with the 'enabled' query param.

examples.summary: List all enabled users including their group and token details

tips: User IDs are always in 'name@realm' format (e.g. 'admin@pam', 'kevin@pve'); use this format when referencing users in ACL or token operations.
The 'tokens' array is only populated when 'full=true'; omitting it keeps the response lean for large user sets.
A non-zero 'tfa-locked-until' value means the user is temporarily locked out of 2FA — useful to surface in monitoring or alerting pipelines.
The 'realm-type' field distinguishes PAM, PVE, LDAP, and AD realms; filter on it client-side to scope operations to a specific auth backend.
